frame.transformOrder: Rx(+pi/2) * site-frame translation * tileset root transform. Apply asset.transform once; GLB positions are original source positions.

processing.geometry: Original NASA first-child meshes plus original root-LoD surrounding context; no added or moved vertices; b3dm repacked as glTF
processing.imageEncoding: JPEG quality95 4:4:4; original pixel dimensions; no sharpening

limitations: Observed finite wedges only; no synthetic ground beyond coverage.
Local graph belongs to this station and is not a registration of existing NOAH-H routes.
NASA-provided stereo and inter-observation alignment are reused but not independently survey-validated.
0.25m grid sampling and geometric slope are prototype proxies, not calibrated EVA traversability or certified safety.
Source mesh uncertainties and unseen sub-grid obstacles remain unresolved.
Rendered NASA LoD is coarser than the source triangles used for the navigation raster.
